paragraphs.text: Voska was a red mage who lived during the Dark Age on Dominaria .

Voska had a major influence in teaching the first skills of magic to Jodah . He is also known for providing Jodah with the notable Reflecting Mirror that allowed him to keep his sanity during his immortal lifespan. After being arrested by the Church of Tal , Voska staged an escape with Jodah, allowing his apprentice to flee the grip of Primata Delphine . Voska himself was found and shot full of crossbow bolts. The Church later put out a rumor that Voska had survived, hoping to lure Jodah back to them. They instead captured Sima trying to investigate the matter of Voska's disappearance.
